question: Where can I get the capacity of the gas grid to receive biomethane injection in Spain, by zone or connection point?

answer.summary: No single national registry publishes biomethane injection capacity by zone or connection point in Spain. Under CNMC Circular 2/2025 (Art. 40), operators must publish capacity by network segment, but only Gas Extremadura publishes granted and in-process injection capacity plus flow percentiles (2023-2025 PDFs for Extremadura). Major DSOs (Nortegas, Nedgia, Redexis, Madrileña Red de Gas) only publish >=16 bar schematics and historical demand/flow proxies, while Enagás Transporte requires registration on ServiceNow; remaining gaps require prior-information requests to each operator.
main_caveats: Despite Circular 2/2025 Art. 40.3 mandating capacity by segment, 4 of 5 major DSOs tested (Nortegas, Nedgia, Redexis, Madrileña) only publish >=16 bar schematics and historical demand/flows, omitting granted or free injection capacity.

Historical gas demand/flows act only as an upper-bound proxy: already-granted or queued injections, downstream sensitive consumers, and reverse-flow limits can reduce or block actual injection capacity.
Enagás Transporte (national primary transmission grid, P > 60 bar) places network schemes, historical consumptions, and biomethane pre-requests behind mandatory company registration on ServiceNow.

Enagás GTS publishes conditional capacity by area ONLY for hydrogen (a gas requiring mixing, Circular 2/2025 Art. 40.2); biomethane does not require mixing and is governed per operator under Art. 40.3.

Published data live in unstandardized PDFs without machine-readable coordinates; Gas Extremadura omits an explicit unit label on its granted and in-process columns (implicitly Nm3/h matching flow rows).
answer.confidence_reason: Directly verified BOE Circular 2/2025 & Res. 13/06/2025, CNMC census/reports, MITECO, Enagás GTS/Transporte, all 5 major DSO portals with downloaded PDFs, 4 minor DSOs, and non-official maps in this session.

steps: Fetch https://biometano.dcgasextremadura.es/consumptions and extract the two PDF links (DEMANDA Y CAPACIDAD REDES DISTRIBUCION and DEMANDA Y CAPACIDAD REDES TRANSPORTE).
Download both PDFs and run pdftotext -layout (or pdfplumber) to parse each named network/pipeline block.

Compare Ya concedida + En tramitación against Q Percentil 5 / Q Percentil 1 and check Flujo Inverso (note granted capacity can exceed local P5 flow when reverse flow is in progress, as on Mérida-Don Benito-Miajadas).
Cross-reference network names with schematic map PDFs on https://biometano.dcgasextremadura.es/network-info to identify municipalities along each pipeline.
reading_traps: Ya concedida and En tramitación lack explicit unit labels in the PDF table; magnitudes match Nm3/h flow rows (e.g. 3,595 granted on Almendralejo-Jerez vs P5 5,800 Nm3/h).

No explicit 'remaining capacity' column exists: without reverse flow, injection above Q Percentil 5/1 faces curtailment; where Flujo Inverso is 'EN TRAMITACIÓN', granted capacity already exceeds local minimum demand.

steps: Select the target DSO portal covering the province/autonomous community (Nortegas, Nedgia, Redexis, or Madrileña Red de Gas).
Download the provincial/regional network schematic PDF to identify the >=16 bar network code (e.g. RED, Posición) and the matching demand/flow PDF.
For Nortegas and Madrileña, use 5th-percentile / minimum hourly flow (Nm3/h or m3/h) as an unadjusted demand-floor proxy; for Nedgia and Redexis, annual energy only indicates annual scale.
To get actual remaining injection capacity after existing reservations and reverse-flow constraints, submit a prior-information request via each operator portal.
reading_traps: None of these 4 DSOs publish already-granted or queued biomethane injection capacity: a high 5th-percentile demand point may already have full capacity reserved.
Redexis serves PDF URLs inside its compiled JS bundle (inyeccion-gases-renovables.redexis.es/build/assets/main-*.js) because /esquema-redes is a client-rendered SPA.
Nedgia's www.nedgia.es triggers a Radware CAPTCHA (HTTP 200 text/html) on rapid repeated requests; fetch PDFs individually and verify Content-Type is application/pdf.
Nortegas's linked Inkolan map viewer (inkolan.atelcosoluciones.es) fails TLS verification with default curl.

regulator.name: Comisión Nacional de los Mercados y la Competencia (CNMC)

operators.note: Primary transmission is led by Enagás Transporte (plus Enagás Transporte del Norte, Redexis Infraestructuras, Reganosa, Gas Natural Transporte SDG, Gas Extremadura Transportista). CNMC distributor census lists 27 entries (22 active companies across ~10 groups: Nedgia [12 entities], Redexis [2], Nortegas, Madrileña Red de Gas, D.C. Gas Extremadura, plus Iberdrola Distribución de Gas [legacy], Tolosa Gasa, Domus Mil Natural, Gas Directo, Gasificadora Regional Canaria).

publication_obligation.norm: Circular 2/2025, de 9 de abril, de la CNMC (Art. 40.1 y 40.3) y Resolución de 13 de junio de 2025 (Apartado Tercero.4-5)
publication_obligation.what_must_be_published: All transmission and distribution network owners must operate free public web platforms publishing >=16 bar network schematics by province, >=3 years of demand at PCTT/PCTD/PCDD, calculation protocols, and for gases not requiring mixing (biomethane) available connection capacity by network segment plus capacity already assigned and in process.
publication_obligation.frequency: Maintained continuously updated ("manteniendo actualizada la información", Art. 40.1 and 40.3), with demand covering at least the 3 preceding years.

consolidated_republication.note: Neither CNMC, MITECO, Enagás GTS, nor Sedigas republishes a consolidated national dataset of biomethane grid injection capacity by zone or connection point. Enagás GTS only publishes area-level conditional capacity for hydrogen (Art. 40.2).

checked_pages.saw: Annual capacity report IS/DE/002/26 (21 Apr 2026) only aggregates Q4 2025 contracts nationally (68 contracts, 7 operators, 20 points: 807 MWh/d transmission, 1,288 MWh/d distribution); no zonal/point breakdown.
General informational page on biomethane; no consolidated capacity dataset or registry.

Rangos Admisibles 2027-2042 (11 Nov 2026) reports national aggregate biomethane connection request counts (591 received, 273 viabilized, 341 in process as of 14/05/2026) and transmission area ranges (Ain/Aout), not biomethane capacity by zone/point.
Industry directory of 7 transporters and 17 distributors; no consolidated injection capacity map or dataset.

national_registry.note: No unified national public registry exists for biomethane gas grid injection capacity in Spain. Publication responsibility is decentralized to individual TSO and DSO connection platforms under CNMC Circular 2/2025 Art. 40.3.

checked_pages.saw: Natural gas registries page redirects to CNMC for supplier lists; contains no biomethane grid capacity registry.
Supervision portal with aggregate reports (IS/DE/002/26, IS/DE/005/26) and individual infrastructure reports (INF/DE/145/26); no national biomethane capacity registry.
GTS processes index has an area-capacity portal only for hydrogen (conexion-hidrogeno/), not for biomethane.
National open data portal returned no datasets on gas grid biomethane injection capacity in searches.

recipe: 1. Identify the network owner for the target municipality/province using CNMC's distributor census (sede.cnmc.gob.es/listado/censo/3) and operator >=16 bar network schematic PDFs (e.g. Nedgia red_<ccaa>.pdf, Redexis province PDFs, Madrileña schematic PDFs, Gas Extremadura /network-info).

2. For Extremadura, extract granted ('Ya concedida'), in-process ('En tramitación'), reverse-flow status, and 2023-2025 P5/P1 flows directly from Gas Extremadura's distribution and transmission capacity PDFs.

3. For Nortegas and Madrileña Red de Gas, extract minimum / 5th-percentile hourly flow (Nm3/h or m3/h) from the provincial/zonal PDFs as an upper-bound demand baseline; for Nedgia and Redexis, extract annual energy (kWh/yr) only as an approximate scale indicator.

4. To obtain exact remaining injection capacity, already-granted capacity, and UTM connection coordinates at a specific point—or anywhere on Enagás Transporte's primary grid—register/submit a 'petición de información previa' (CNMC Res. 13/06/2025 Apartado Cuarto), which the operator must answer within 1 month.
5. Cross-check CNMC authorization reports (cnmc.es) and BOE/regional gazette/EIA filings to spot new biomethane injection connections not yet reflected in annual PDFs.
if_unstructured.location_method: Extract named PCTD/ERM codes from operator schematic PDFs (which contain vector/raster maps without coordinates) or cadastral polygon/parcel identifiers and UTM coordinates from prior-information responses and CNMC/EIA authorization documents (e.g., INF/DE/145/26), then locate them via Catastro WMS or PNOA orthophotos.
cross_with: Enagás GTS Rangos Admisibles 2027-2042 (national request/viability totals and transmission area stress-test ranges)
CNMC IS/DE/002/26 and IS/DE/005/26 annual gas supervision reports

where_published.name: Mandatory Operator Prior Information Requests (Petición de información previa, CNMC Res. 13/06/2025)
where_published.what: Non-binding regulatory inquiry mechanism through each TSO/DSO single-contact portal where operators must provide point-specific capacity data within 1 month.
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Submit plant UTM coordinates, delivery pressure, and min/max daily flow via the operator's web portal (e.g., Enagás ServiceNow, Nedgia SCI, Redexis, Nortegas, Madrileña Forms, Gas Extremadura GERenovables).

example_document.what_it_gives: Apartado Cuarto.3 specifies mandatory output fields: 'indicando, al menos, los puntos de conexión posibles (coordenadas UTM), y para las redes de transporte secundario y distribución, los caudales máximo, mínimo, percentil 95, percentil 5 y medio anual de gas vehiculado por la red al menos del último año, la capacidad condicional de conexión ya concedida y la solicitada en tramitación en la misma red.'

where_published.name: CNMC Infrastructure Authorization Reports (Expedientes de Energía)
where_published.what: Advisory Council reports on DGPEM authorizations for new transmission/injection positions (PCTG), giving pipeline specs, nominal/min/max biomethane flow, pressure, and parcel locations.
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Search CNMC expedientes for 'inyección de biometano' or 'PCTG' under Energia -> Mercado de gas or Expedientes.

example_document.what_it_gives: INF/DE/145/26 (30 Jul 2026, Sanchonuño/Segovia Norte PCTG, p. 3): 'adyacentes a la posición CUEVAL-01 (Sanchonuño), vértices V-0 y V-1 de la posición, en las parcelas 130 y 131 del Polígono 2 de Sanchonuño' and 'presión máxima de operación (MOP) de 59 bar y un caudal nominal de 800 Nm3/h, con un mínimo de 300 Nm3/h y un máximo de 960 Nm3/h.'

where_published.name: Official Gazettes & Environmental Assessment Portals (BOE, Regional Bulletins like BOA, and MITECO SABIA)
where_published.what: Public declarations of biomethane plants and connecting pipelines (EIAs, AAIs, and autonomous interest declarations) naming promoters, target gas pipelines, and plant output capacities.
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Search BOE (boe.es/buscar/), MITECO SABIA (sede.miteco.gob.es/.../navServicioContenido), or regional gazettes by keywords 'biometano', 'inyección', and 'gasoducto'.

related_not_answering.name: Enagás Transporte — Inventario de Conexiones PCTT
related_not_answering.why: Lists existing transmission-to-transmission interconnection points (PCTT) and operating pressures (rev. sep-23), not biomethane injection capacity.

open_questions: What exact remaining available biomethane injection capacity and queued requests exist inside Enagás Transporte's registration-gated ServiceNow platform, and when will Enagás, Nedgia, Nortegas, Redexis, and Madrileña Red de Gas publish remaining/assigned capacity by segment as required by Circular 2/2025 Art. 40.3?

Do minor local distributors (Tolosa Gasa, Gas Directo, Domus Mil Natural, Gasificadora Regional Canaria) or other TSOs (Reganosa, Enagás Transportes del Norte) hold unpublished capacity figures accessible only via individual prior-information requests?

history.note: First-pass research: Circular 2/2025 mandates capacity by segment, but only Gas Extremadura publishes granted/queued capacity; 4 major DSOs publish demand proxies and Enagas requires login.

local_terms.meaning: Conditional firm connection/access capacity granted to renewable gas plants subject to predefined flow, demand, and gas-quality conditions.
Legal category in Circular 2/2025 for injectable non-fossil gases; split into gases not needing mixing (biomethane) and gases needing mixing (hydrogen).
Reverse flow from a distribution/secondary grid upstream into transmission when biomethane supply exceeds local downstream demand.
Connection points between transmission-transmission (PCTT), transmission-distribution (PCTD), and distribution-distribution (PCDD) networks.
Connection point for biomethane/renewable gas injection into a transmission pipeline (punto de conexión para inyección en gasoducto de transporte).
Spanish gas grid tiers under Law 34/1998: >=60 bar (primary transmission), 16-60 bar (secondary transmission), and <=16 bar (distribution).
Formal pre-application inquiry (Res. 13/06/2025 Apartado Cuarto) requiring network owners to reply within 1 month with UTM points, P5/P95 flows, and granted/queued capacity.
Sistema Logístico de Acceso de Terceros, the Enagás GTS platform where commissioned biomethane injection points are registered for PVB market access.
